description: This file contains unit tests for the WebAppCache class in the Apache OFBiz project, verifying its behavior regarding retrieval and management of WebappInfo objects, including filtering, caching, and handling of conflicting attributes.

classes.name: WebAppCacheTest
classes.description: JUnit test class testing the functionality of WebAppCache, including webapp info retrieval, filtering, caching behavior, position conflicts, display flags, and mount point handling.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment before each test, setting up the component configuration source and WebAppCache instance.

methods.name: getAppBarWebInfosBasic
methods.description: Tests that getAppBarWebInfos returns correct WebappInfo objects based on server name.

methods.name: getAppBarWebInfosBasicWithMenu
methods.description: Verifies filtering of WebappInfo objects by menuName parameter.

methods.name: getAppBarWebInfosMemoization
methods.description: Checks that the WebAppCache correctly memoizes or caches the results to prevent repeated recalculations.

methods.name: getAppBarWebInfosSamePosition
methods.description: Ensures that WebappInfo objects with the same position conflict resolve to a consistent order.

methods.name: getAppBarWebInfosSameTitle
methods.description: Verifies that WebappInfo objects with the same title are both retained when no position conflict exists.

methods.name: getAppBarWebInfosPositionTitle
methods.description: Tests that positions override titles when both are specified.

methods.name: getAppBarWebInfosDisplayFalse
methods.description: Checks that WebappInfo objects with appBarDisplay set to false are ignored in specific retrieval contexts.

methods.name: getWebappInfoBasic
methods.description: Verifies correct WebappInfo retrieval based on server and mount point.
